hostOS is unstated: no worker's os-release could be read, which on a probe is the host's root filesystem not having been mounted into it. The cluster this expands into states no host OS either
enableJournalDevice is set because spec.discover.forceJournalDevice asked for it: the smallest disk of every node carries the journal instead of data, the smallest named being 1.74T (/dev/disk/by-id/nvme-eui.34333930547013130025384300000001) on worker-1. This is the line to remove to carve the journal from a partition instead
stripe is 1+0 as a single-node cluster (clusterMode Single), which protects nothing: the worker hands over 1 device for data, and a redundant scheme places each chunk of a stripe on its own device, so 1+1 needs two. A cluster's stripe cannot be changed afterward
enableMetadataJournal is off, because every device completes a 4K write whole as a storage node will have it: its blocks are 4K, or the atomic write unit it reports covers 4K.
